info.name: Car-Go Connect API
info.description: The following API is for a vehicle rental management system built using Python, Flask and SQLAlchemy. The API allows users to view available vehicles, see rented vehicles, add new vehicles to the fleet, rent vehicles and return rented vehicles. It also provides cross-branch fleet search and RBAC for staff management.

request.description: Tests the vehicle search endpoint by filtering vehicles by fleet branch and returns all vehicles matching the specified branch.

response.name: Filter Vehicles By Branch

item.name: Filter Vehicles by Branch and Category

request.description: Tests the vehicle search endpoint by filtering vehicles by both fleet branch and category and returns all vehicles matching the specified filters.

response.name: Filter Vehicles by Branch and Category

request.description: Authenticates a user, in this case, management and returns a JWT access token. For demonstration purposes, the login details were hard-coded within the actual authorisation file. Copy and paste the details in the Body tab under **raw** and then **JSON**. It then generates a random access token for RBAC-restricted resources such as viewing a fleet summary report. To use this access token, please see the next request in the folder titled "Fleet Summary Report (Management Only)."

Returns fleet utilisation statistics for each branch, including:

- the total count of vehicles
    
- the total count of rented vehicles
    
- utilisation rate (percentage of vehicles in a branch that are rented out)
    

Access is limited to authenticated users with the management role to support RBAC capabilities.

Use the copied access token generated in the login page to gain access to the management-only Fleet Summary Report page. Open the Authorization tab, select **Bearer** token under Auth Type and paste the access token in the **Token** input field.

response.name: Fleet Summary Report - No Token Given

request.description: Returns a list of all vehicles in the rental fleet across all branches, including available, rented, damaged or service-requested vehicles.
